actual.descripcion: BMW Championship, First Round | The 2026 BMW Championship begins as 50 players face off in Round 1 at the Bellerive Country Club. Scottie Scheffler, Matt Fitzpatrick, Cameron Young and Si Woo Kim take on the 7,448 yards Zoysia grass fairways in St. Louis.

siguiente.titulo: DP World Tour Golf • Nexo Championship, Second Round
siguiente.descripcion: Nexo Championship, Second Round | Round 2 of the Nexo Championship gets underway. The 156-player field will be cut to the top 65 and ties as golfers navigate severe weather conditions. Players below the cut line are eliminated and will not receive a share of the prize pool.
